subject: The rule that cuts winners is dormant - and fixing sizing would switch it on
body:
One finding that changes the sizing decision you have pending, so flagging it before you
decide rather than after.

ManagePartialProfits takes 30-50% off a position once price moves 1.5-3.5 ATR in your favour.
It has no on/off input -- it is unconditionally active -- and it only ever fires on trades that
are winning. The UNIFIED 5 audit is right that this is a rule written to cut and never to hold.

But it has never actually run. The guard is `lotSize >= 0.02`, and every position this build
opens is broker minimum, 0.01 lots, because of the sizing chain that is discarded. So the rule
is dormant.

That links two things I had been holding for you separately:

If you wire the sizing chain, you do not just get bigger positions. You also switch on a rule
that cuts 30-50% off every winner at 1.5-3.5 ATR -- on a system whose measured problem is
already that it takes small wins and large losses. Realised reward:risk from your own export is
1.475 (average win 1.396R, average loss 0.947R). Activating partial profits at the same moment
positions become large enough to matter would push that down.

So my recommendation: do not ship the sizing fix alone. Decide sizing and partial-profit gating
together, or gate the partials first.

Nothing shipped for this one -- the rule is inert, adding an input gate is a design choice, and
the right sequencing is yours.

Ten EA fixes are live from tonight. Still waiting on you: rotate the Anthropic API key, and this
paired sizing decision.
